summary: @veganstraightedge working on WordPress exit plan. Original thinking was use Known as social stream and afew static html pages. But I have always loved what you built in RoR. Then I go and see your Dark Matter work, intrigued. Better than spinning up Sinatra or FrancisCMS?

body_html:
@veganstraightedge working on WordPress exit plan. Original thinking was use Known as social stream and afew static html pages.

But I have always loved what you built in RoR. Then I go and see your Dark Matter work, intrigued.

Better than spinning up Sinatra or FrancisCMS?
